abstract: An endodermal sinus tumour of the ovary from a 12 year old girl is analysed light- and electron microscopically. The histological appearance is characterized by glandular-papillary structures and microcystic-reticular areas with inclusion of occasional endodermal sinuses. By electron microscopy immature and highly differentiated cells can be distinguished. In analogy to certain structures in the human yolk sac the most differentiated cells in the tumour are regarded as neoplastic endoderm. On the basis of transitional forms between immature and differentiated cells a development of the latter from the former is suggested. The cells in mesenchyme-like areas differ from those of solid and glandular parts merely in the degree of cytoplasmic differentiation but are otherwise believed to represent the same "cell line". In addition to other possible cell functions the cytoplasmic features of the differentiated cell indicates a protein synthesis and secretion. From our observations it is concluded that the endodermal sinus tumour originates from germ cells and differentiates into yolk sac endoderm. The ultrastructural differences between this tumour and clear cell carcinomas of the ovary are discussed.
abstract_ja: 12歳の女児の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍を光学顕微鏡および電子顕微鏡で解析した。組織像は腺乳頭状構造と微小嚢胞網状領域を特徴とし、卵黄嚢様構造を一部含んでいた。電子顕微鏡では未熟な細胞と高度に分化した細胞を区別できた。卵黄嚢の構造との類似性から、最も分化した腫瘍細胞を腫瘍性の内胚葉とみなした。未熟細胞と分化細胞の移行像から、後者は前者から分化すると考えられる。間葉様領域の細胞は、充実性および腺状部分の細胞と細胞質の分化の程度のみが異なり、同じ細胞系列を表すと考えられる。細胞質の特徴は、分化細胞がタンパク質の合成と分泌を行うことを示唆する。以上の観察から、この腫瘍は胚細胞に由来し、卵黄嚢の内胚葉へ分化すると結論づけた。本腫瘍と卵巣明細胞癌との超微細構造の違いについても考察した。
